items.title: Zscaler and SentinelOne Spike 10% as Cybersecurity Re-Rating Reaches the Laggards
items.summary: CrowdStrike and Okta dropped results after Wednesday's close, and the shockwave landed hardest on the cybersecurity names the market had spent months punishing. The rotation playing out Thursday reveals something unusual about where sentiment repair actually goes.

items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Following CMMC Level 2 Certification Has A Pricey Narrative
items.summary: Fortinet (FTNT) is in focus after its Fortinet Federal subsidiary received Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Level 2. This confirms alignment with 110 NIST SP 800-171 controls for handling Controlled Unclassified Information. items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Rally on Twin Earnings Beats: Okta Spikes 22%, CrowdStrike Jumps 13%
items.summary: Okta and CrowdStrike both crushed earnings, but one stock is surging nearly twice as hard as the other despite posting slower growth and a troubling dip in a key bookings metric.

items.title: Is PANW Stock Gearing Up For A Massive Volatility Shock?
items.summary: The options market is charging more than this stock's own past year of movement would justify, and the range it prices runs from a level inside the past year's trading range to one well above the top of it.

items.title: Palo Alto Stock Is Riding A Wave Of AI Fear, But What Happens Next?
items.summary: Management raised the bar on its future, and after a moment of doubt, investors have been piling in ever since, forcing a critical question about how much momentum is left.

items.title: Cisco Expands Secure AI Factory: Can it Outpace PANW & FTNT?
items.summary: CSCO expands its Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, embedding security into AI infrastructure as cyber threats rise and competition intensifies.

items.title: Cisco Systems Stock Ran On Orders Its Revenue Had Not Caught Up To
items.summary: The AI order book was public and escalating for three straight quarters before the shares moved.

items.title: History Has An Opinion On This SNPS Price Level
items.summary: A critical piece of the AI supply chain has seen its stock slide back to a familiar floor, forcing investors to ask if history's powerful rebound rhyme is about to repeat.
